description: Both switches, SW-CORE-01 and the daisy-chained SW-EDGE-02, tested together through the test switch. Laptop 192.168.1.240 (wired) -> test switch NETTEST Gi1/0/24; test switch Gi1/0/23 -> PP-Z:23 = PP-A:23 -> SW-CORE-01 Gi1/0/23; SW-CORE-01 Gi1/0/24 -> SW-EDGE-02 Gi1/0/1 (copper daisy chain). Test switch settings are in test_switch, the production switches' read-only logins (for the Switch Port Audit) in switches. Passwords are never saved.

Unused run under test in the diagram: PP-Z:5 = PP-A:5, verified from a test-switch copper port (Gi1/0/1-22).
Test kit's only link to production: access port in the devices' VLAN. Lets the laptop reach both switches and their devices. Remove after testing.

Copper uplink to the daisy-chained switch; ip is SW-EDGE-02's management address. The Switch Port Audit reports this port as an uplink (WARN) and finds SW-EDGE-02's devices when SW-EDGE-02 itself is audited.
Fiber channel 1, used for the fiber test only: test switch Te1/1/1 -> SW-CORE-01 Te1/1. SFP-10GSR-85-I at both ends.
Fiber channel 2: test switch Te1/1/2 -> SW-CORE-01 Te1/2. SFP-10GSR-85-I at both ends.
Copper uplink back to the production switch; ip is SW-CORE-01's management address. All test traffic to SW-EDGE-02 arrives through this link.
